$comment: §14: '≥200 hand-labelled messages spanning true positives (phone numbers,
"call me," "let's sort this directly") and known false positives ("call the
pharmacy," "the manager will call you about the roster"). Generatable as a
starting draft; must be human-reviewed for labels before a false-positive
rate derived from it means anything.'
This IS that starting draft, and every entry carries reviewed:false to say
so. The labels here were written by the same process that wrote the
regexes, which means a false-positive rate measured against them measures
the author's consistency, not the detector's accuracy. The harness in
test/gates/disintermediation.test.ts refuses to treat the number as real
until reviewed:true appears, and §15 keeps the gate open until then.
To review: read each entry, correct the label if it is wrong, and set
reviewed to true. Entries a reviewer disagrees about are the valuable ones
